Workflow.name: Emergency Identity Status Management Workflow

Variable.name: launcher
Variable.Description: The administrator who opened the quick link.

Workflow.Description: Disables or re-enables an identity and its accounts by setting the Emergency Disable attribute.

Form.name: Emergency Identity Disable / Enable
Form.Description: Select an identity. Active identities can only be disabled; disabled identities can only be enabled. All accounts follow, without approval.
